moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Match Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is back this Friday as champions Arsenal take on new boys Coventry City. Who are you backing for the opening weekend?

angles.name: New Season Buzz
angles.copy: New managers, new signings, and new hopes! The 2026/27 Premier League season gets underway this weekend. What's your big prediction?

moments.title: Ariana Grande at The O2
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' with dates at London's O2 Arena tonight, August 19th, and tomorrow.

angles.name: London Shows Tonight
angles.copy: Ariana Grande takes over The O2 London tonight and tomorrow! Who's heading down for 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

angles.name: Pop Queen in Town
angles.copy: Our favourite pop queen is in London! Ariana Grande is live at The O2 tonight. Expect all the hits and those incredible vocals.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his spectacular 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley Stadium tonight, August 19th, for a massive London show.

angles.name: Wembley Stadium Show
angles.copy: The Weeknd is live at Wembley Stadium tonight! Are you ready for the 'After Hours Til Dawn' experience?

angles.name: Epic London Performance
angles.copy: Expect an incredible night as The Weeknd lights up Wembley Stadium tonight. It's going to be massive!

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires Live
moments.blurb: Rock supergroup Hollywood Vampires, featuring Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, and Joe Perry, are playing Utilita Arena Birmingham tonight, August 19th.

angles.name: Rock Supergroup Tonight
angles.copy: Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp & Joe Perry are bringing Hollywood Vampires to Birmingham tonight! Who's ready for some rock 'n' roll?

angles.name: Legends on Stage
angles.copy: Three rock legends on one stage! Hollywood Vampires are in Birmingham tonight. A rare chance to see these icons perform.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's 'We Out Here Festival', celebrating jazz, hip hop, house, and electronica, is currently underway in Dorset until August 23rd, and is sold out.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of jazz, hip hop, and electronic music to Dorset this weekend. Who's there for the vibes?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: Another sold-out success! We Out Here Festival continues its celebration of diverse music genres in Dorset until Sunday.

moments.title: ArcTanGent Festival Live
moments.blurb: The ArcTanGent Festival, offering four days of post-rock, math rock, and experimental metal, is currently live near Bristol.

angles.name: Metal & Math Rock Festival
angles.copy: ArcTanGent Festival is live right now! Four days of the best post-rock, math rock, and experimental metal. Who's getting heavy?

angles.name: Unique Festival Experience
angles.copy: Looking for something different? ArcTanGent Festival is delivering an intense and unique music experience near Bristol this week.

moments.title: Victorious Festival Next Weekend
moments.blurb: Portsmouth's Victorious Festival, known for its scenic location, is set to kick off next bank holiday weekend, August 28th-30th, featuring a huge lineup of artists.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Festival
angles.copy: Get ready for the bank holiday weekend! Victorious Festival in Portsmouth is just days away. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Seaside Music Fun
angles.copy: Sun, sea, and incredible music! Victorious Festival kicks off next Friday. The perfect way to end the summer.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Soon
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals return next bank holiday weekend, August 28th-30th, with massive headliners across rock, indie, and pop.

angles.name: Festival Institution
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds are just around the corner! Who's heading to one of the UK's biggest festivals this bank holiday weekend?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Anthems
angles.copy: Ready for a weekend of epic music? Reading & Leeds Festivals are almost here, bringing huge names to close out the summer.

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue Chart Hit
moments.blurb: Pop icons Madonna and Kylie Minogue scored a new top 10 hit with their collaboration 'Love Sensation,' which debuted on the UK Singles Chart last week.

angles.name: Pop Legends Unite
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue in the Top 10 together! 'Love Sensation' is still on repeat here. What a collaboration!

angles.name: Chart Success
angles.copy: Two queens of pop, Madonna and Kylie, proving they've still got it with a new Top 10 hit. An iconic team-up!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' holds the record as the longest-running UK number-one single of all time, with 21 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Longest Running Number One
angles.copy: A truly incredible achievement! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the longest-running UK number one ever. What a track!

angles.name: Chart History Makers
angles.copy: Making history! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has broken records on the UK Singles Chart. Pure talent.

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just around the corner, falling on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Hands up if you're already planning your Summer Bank Holiday weekend! Just over a week to go until that extra day off. What are your plans?

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: The Summer Bank Holiday is almost here! Time to make the most of the last long weekend before autumn truly sets in. How will you be spending it in Wales?

moments.title: Happy 81st to Ian Gillan
moments.blurb: Legendary Deep Purple frontman and iconic rock vocalist Ian Gillan celebrates his 81st birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the incredible Ian Gillan of Deep Purple! A true voice of rock.

angles.name: Deep Purple Legend
angles.copy: From 'Smoke on the Water' to 'Jesus Christ Superstar,' Ian Gillan's voice is unmistakable. Happy 81st to a rock legend!

moments.title: Happy 75th to John Deacon
moments.blurb: Queen's iconic bassist and songwriter, responsible for hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want to Break Free,' John Deacon turns 75 today, August 19th.

angles.name: Queen Bassist's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant John Deacon! The man behind some of Queen's greatest basslines and songs.

angles.name: Hit Songwriter
angles.copy: Celebrating John Deacon of Queen on his 75th birthday! A true musical genius who gave us so many unforgettable tracks.

moments.title: Happy 40th to Christina Perri
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Christina Perri, known for emotional hits like 'Jar of Hearts' and 'A Thousand Years,' celebrates her 40th birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Pop Star's Milestone
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 40th birthday to the wonderful Christina Perri! Still loving 'Jar of Hearts' all these years later.

angles.name: Queen of Ballads
angles.copy: From wedding anthems to heartbreak hits, Christina Perri has given us so many unforgettable songs. Happy 40th!

moments.title: Happy 56th to Fat Joe
moments.blurb: American rapper and Terror Squad founder Fat Joe, known for multiplatinum hits like 'Lean Back,' turns 56 today, August 19th.

angles.name: Hip Hop Veteran's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Fat Joe! Still got 'Lean Back' stuck in our heads.

angles.name: Bronx Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the Bronx legend Fat Joe on his 56th birthday! A true icon of hip hop.

moments.title: Happy 60th to GZA
moments.blurb: Wu-Tang Clan co-founder and hip-hop legend GZA (The Genius) celebrates his 60th birthday on Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Hip Hop Pioneer's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 60th birthday to the legendary GZA of Wu-Tang Clan this Saturday! The Genius indeed.

angles.name: Wu-Tang Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating a true pioneer of hip hop! GZA turns 60 this weekend. What's your favourite Wu-Tang track?

moments.title: Happy 61st to Shania Twain
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known for anthems like 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much,' turns 61 on August 28th.

angles.name: Country Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! Still feeling like a woman, man!

angles.name: Pop Crossover Star
angles.copy: From country to global pop icon! Happy 61st to Shania Twain this Friday. What's your favourite Shania hit?

moments.title: Happy 40th to Lea Michele
moments.blurb: Actress and singer Lea Michele, best known for her role as Rachel Berry in 'Glee' and her acclaimed Broadway career, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 29th.

angles.name: Glee Star's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 40th birthday to the incredibly talented Lea Michele this Saturday! From Broadway to 'Glee,' she's done it all.

angles.name: Broadway & TV Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Lea Michele's 40th this weekend! Who remembers her iconic performances as Rachel Berry in 'Glee'?
